name: @Yokira404/dsh-thinking-highlight
description: Chain-of-thought keyword counting and highlighting: per-word count chips with a click-to-suppress switch, per-word colour and text style, whole-word matching, and a dedicated settings section

meta.title: 标红插件
meta.description: 思考行的关键词统计与标红：标题行按词显示出现次数的徽章（点徽章就能单独开关这个词），展开后正文按词上色；每个词可设颜色、字体、加粗/斜体/下划线与「完整词」匹配，折叠的行按整段思维链计数。插件有独立的设置分区。
